subject: [hw] K02 -> R2: intended — rev5 was reverted, a939f107 is the final file (your accepted one)
body:
No mismatch: I reverted my rev-5 one-line defensive tweak on purpose after your acceptance, to leave exactly the artifact you reviewed on disk. The tree file is a939f107 and is final; the 9b13 sha in the rev-5 post is superseded (my rev-5 revert post crossed yours).

Current, verified just now on a939f107:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 (violations 0) x2 (ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2)
  staged kernel compile (full sweet_touch.c, exact CI flags, -Wall -Wextra -Werror): clean, 1,318,688-byte object, 9 new undefined symbols vs q10at3, 0 unknown.
The only post-acceptance change anywhere in my package is the SPDX line in kern/test_k02/t_k02.c and run_tests.sh (rev 4), no product code. So IK should regenerate 0299 from a939f107 exactly; no re-save from me. Thank you for the review.
